watch.text: Jaylen Brown (34.7 mpg) and Dean Wade (26.7 mpg) are out vs MIL with hamstring injuries and Tyrese Maxey (36.1 mpg, foot) is questionable; all three missed the last game.
Cameron Boozer (30.8 mpg, ankle), Jerami Grant (22.1) and Javon Small (22.2) are all out at MIN on 11/21; none had missed a game before.
Dylan Harper (31.7 mpg, hip) is out two to three weeks as of 11/19; ratings were built with him playing 15 of 16 games.
Jayson Tatum (rest) and Derrick White (shoulder) are questionable at SAC; neither has missed a game yet this season.
P.J. Washington (30.9 mpg, shoulder impingement) and Walter Clayton Jr. (knee) are questionable vs LAC; Dereck Lively II (foot) is still out, ESPN estimates Nov 27.
Anthony Edwards (33.8 mpg) has missed 10 of 16 games after right-knee arthroscopy; early-season ratings still carry the games he played.
Dejounte Murray (31.4 mpg, ankle) has missed the last three games; Trendon Watford and Bennedict Mathurin also sat 11/20 at OKC.

swings.DAL: Nothing clear found: the market moved on DAL without a clear reason; P.J. Washington (shoulder) and Walter Clayton Jr. (knee) were listed questionable 11/20 (Heavy, 11/21).

swings.MEM: Cameron Boozer (ankle), Jerami Grant (calf) and Javon Small (personal) were ruled out for MIN on 11/20-21; the market prices it, our ratings don't (ESPN, 11/21).
swings.MIN: Nothing found: the market moved on MIN without a clear reason; Edwards is still out and MIN lost 102-99 at NY on 11/19, but MEM's three absences pull the line MIN's way (ESPN).
